by hand: with tapers (1, 1)/sqrt 2 and (1, -1)/sqrt 2, U = (sqrt 2, 0); bin 0 has X = (4, 2)/sqrt 2, so mu = 2, F = 1*4*2/2 = 4; bin 1 has X = (2, 4)/sqrt 2, so mu = 1, F = 2/8 = 0.25; p = 1/(1 + F)
by hand: all-zero input has mu = 0 and residual 0, so F = 0 and p = 1
